detail.longDescription: I made a tool you can use to evaluate whether the supplements you buy are really effective? Most of this was made before the age of AI but I struggled with the technical aspect of how to implement it. So, before when people I knew asked me about supplements i'd have to answer them 1 by 1. Now I tell them to use the checker. You can request a specific supplement or brand to be researched in our discord https://discord.com/invite/S7exQU9r9y
